title_en: Famous Restaurants (6/20): Jianshe Road Snack Street
note_en: 越…越… works like English "the more…, the more…": 时间越晚，这条街就越热闹 "The later it gets, the livelier the street becomes." Each 越 goes right before the adjective or verb it intensifies, and 就 often joins the second half; the same text pairs them again in 人越多，气氛就越高涨 "the bigger the crowd, the higher the spirits."
